rules.name: CVE-2026-33824 — Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-33824: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.. Product: Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions
rules.aql_query: SELECT * FROM events WHERE (PAYLOAD LIKE '%CVE-2026-33824%' OR PAYLOAD LIKE '%INTERNET KEY EXCHANGE (IKE) SERVICE EXTENSIONS%') AND SEVERITY >= 5 LAST 15 MINUTES
